name: Light Spear
description: Condense a short spear of light in the hand and throw it at the chest of an opponent.

name: Tip Flash
description: Jab the point of the spear into the guard of an opponent so that a flash bursts at the contact.

name: Glare Parry
description: Sweep the shaft of the spear across an incoming cut and throw it wide on a burst of glare.

name: Spear Reading
description: Send the spear point ahead as a ray of light and read the shapes it touches at its full length.

name: Quick Spear
description: Snap a thin spear from the wrist in a straight bright line before the opponent can step off it.

name: Radiant Lance
description: Drive a long lance of white light through the guard of an opponent and burn the flesh behind it.

name: Lance Barrage
description: Loose a quick run of short lances that strike one after another along a single line.

name: Lance Pin
description: Spear the shadow or the clothing of an opponent with a lance of light and hold the opponent in place.

name: Zenith Lance
description: Gather the full height of the sun into one lance and drive it through plate and bone in a single white line.

name: Falling Spear
description: Leap and hurl the lance down from above so it lands with the weight of the user and the burn of noon.

name: Sunwell Touch
description: Draw a small well of warmth into the fingertips and close a shallow wound of an ally or the self.

name: Pulse Glow
description: Rest a glowing hand on a patient and read the strength of the heartbeat by the warmth in the palm.

name: Soothing Light
description: Pour a soft light over a swollen joint of an ally or the self until the swelling goes down.

name: Gentle Rouse
description: Wake a fainting ally with a quick pulse of warmth through the chest and the wrists.

name: Veil Light
description: Stretch a thin veil of light over a wounded ally to turn a stray blow aside while the healer works.

name: Sunfever Break
description: Draw the burning fever out of an ally with cool strokes of gentle sun qi until the sweat comes.

name: Poison Burnout
description: Burn a creeping poison out of the blood of an ally or the self with a clean steady heat.

name: Wound Radiance
description: Pour a bright steady radiance into an open wound of an ally or the self until the flesh meets.

name: Vital Flush
description: Flush the face and limbs of a spent ally with vital heat so the body stands up and fights on.

name: Sunrise Revival
description: Pour a rising flood of sun qi into the chest of an ally whose breath stopped moments ago and call the life back.

name: Golden Restoration
description: Bathe a gravely wounded ally in a deep gold glow that knits muscle and skin together over many breaths.

name: Shimmer Haze
description: Raise a shimmering heat in the nearby air so that distances and shapes waver for those who look through it.

name: Warm Glow
description: Hold a pleasant warmth over the qi field so allies standing in it move with loose and ready limbs.

name: Daystar Sense
description: Let the warm field report each body that crosses it and how fast it moves.

name: Glow Spill
description: Spill a sheet of glaring light across the ground that scorches the feet of those who stand in it.

name: Light Weight
description: Lay a hot heavy light on the shoulders of nearby opponents so their steps drag.

name: Scorching Heat
description: Raise the heat of the whole field until the air burns the lungs and cloth of those who stay in it.

name: Saturating Glare
description: Fill the field with a white glare so thick that opponents cannot gather their own qi to strike.

name: Sun Cleanse
description: Burn foul vapours and creeping taint out of the air and the bodies of allies standing in the field.

name: Daystar Shell
description: Close the field into a bright shell round the user and nearby allies that blocks heavy attacks from every side.

name: Blazing Flash
description: Gather the whole field into one flash and let it burn outward over every opponent within the user's reach.

name: Twin Glint
description: Throw a glint from each hand at the same moment so two stings land on opposite sides.

name: Clapping Sun
description: Strike with both palms in a clap that catches the head of an opponent between two hot blows.

name: Mirror Glow
description: Hold up two mirrored glows that pass a blow from one to the other and spin it away.

name: Twinsun Sense
description: Read the heat of two foes at once and learn which of them is the more hurt.

name: Paired Flare
description: Burst a flare from each hand and let the two blooms overlap to scorch a wide patch of ground.

name: Twinsun Mend
description: Rest a warm hand on each of two wounded allies and mend them both at the same pace.

name: Paired Lash
description: Whip two ribbons of heat round the wrists of an opponent and draw them together.

name: Twin Suns
description: Hold a small sun in each hand and fling them together so they merge into one great burn on the target.

name: Paired Radiance
description: Pour one sun into a wounded ally and one into a weary ally and restore and rouse them in the same breath.

name: Noble Glow
description: Wear a dignified gold glow that blunts the first blow to fall on the user.

name: Stern Light
description: Turn a cold hard light on an unruly opponent so that raised hands fall.

name: Rebuke Flash
description: Cuff an opponent with a flash of light on the cheek and the eye as a sharp rebuke.

name: Highsun Stride
description: Take a long step on a bar of light and arrive exactly where the user means to stand.

name: Judging Eye
description: Turn a still bright look on a speaker and tell by the flicker of heat whether the speaker lies.

name: Sovereign Warmth
description: Spread a ruling warmth over allies nearby so their backs straighten and their blows come harder.

name: Chastising Beam
description: Cast a stiff beam that strikes an opponent hard in the chest as a reproof.

name: Unyielding Glow
description: Keep up a proud bright shield that does not bend however many blows are spent upon it.

name: Judging Radiance
description: Cast a heavy radiance that presses on all hostile qi in sight and forces the rash to stand down.

name: Crowning Blaze
description: Raise a crown of fire and bring it down on a single opponent with the force of a sentence.

name: Track Sense
description: Run two threads of warm qi through the nearby air and tell the wounded from the whole by the answer.

name: Burn Ray
description: Cast a hot straight line at an opponent along the first track of qi.

name: Mend Ray
description: Run the second track of qi into an ally and let it close small hurts as it goes.

name: Cross Glow
description: Cross the two tracks before the chest into a bright X that stops a thrust.

name: Double Current
description: Strike an opponent with a burning palm while the other palm mends an ally at the user's side.

name: Parallel Ray
description: Hold two rays side by side on an opponent and sweep them together in a hot stripe.

name: Pairwise Purge
description: Burn taint out with one track while the other washes the cleaned flesh in warmth.

name: Dual Sunwave
description: Roll two waves of sun qi out from the user on the two tracks so they meet on the foe in a double blow.

name: Balanced Restoration
description: Run both tracks as mending warmth through a grievously wounded ally until the body steadies on both sides.

name: Oath Warmth
description: Pledge the healing hand to an ally and let a steady warmth run from it into the hurt.

name: Oath Glow
description: Swear to stand between a blow and a companion and raise a glow that takes the blow.

name: Vow Rouse
description: Speak the vow aloud and lend its warmth to the sinking courage of an ally.

name: Daybreak Sense
description: Open the senses like the first light of day and find the nearest ally in need.

name: Sunvow Palm
description: Strike with a sworn palm that pushes an attacker back from a companion.

name: Vowed Ember
description: Press a bright ember of qi into a deep cut and let it seal the bleeding at once.

name: Sunoath Purge
description: Burn a curse or taint out of a companion while the vow holds and the heat does not waver.

name: Vigil Mending
description: Keep a sleepless watch over a hurt ally and feed the wound with warmth through the hours.

name: Sworn Burst
description: Burst into hot light to drive off those pressing on a fallen companion.

name: Daybreak Revival
description: Spend the user's own warmth to call back a companion whose pulse has only just stopped.

name: Oathbound Radiance
description: Cast a vast bright guard over every companion in reach and hold it for as long as the vow stands.

name: Open Blaze
description: Strike with an open hand blazing in plain view so that the opponent must meet it.

name: Clear Light
description: Hold a plain clear light before the body that turns a blow with no tricks.

name: Clear Rouse
description: Clear the fog from the head of a dazed ally with a bright pulse of qi.

name: Sunwide Glow
description: Spread a wide even glow and watch for anything that casts a shadow within it.

name: Bare Flash
description: Throw a bare white flash that ruins the aim of an archer or a caster in mid-draw.

name: Clearing Burn
description: Burn a binding or lingering taint from an ally with a clean white heat that leaves no mark.

name: Open Beam
description: Drive a plain straight beam through a screen of smoke or cloth and burn what lies behind it.

name: Noon Surge
description: Surge the full strength of noon through the arms and legs of a flagging ally.

name: Zenith Burst
description: Gather the sun at its height and burst it over every opponent in the open ground before the user.

name: Unveiling Sun
description: Pour a light so complete that it tears away every veil and every trick of cover from those within it.

name: Wide Scorch
description: Sweep a wide arc of heat before the user and scorch everything that stands in it.

name: Endless Glow
description: Hold an ever-flowing glow round an ally that keeps the limbs fresh through a long fight.

name: Sprawling Ray
description: Spread a ray into a broad flat sheet that sears a line across the front of a group.

name: Open Heat
description: Let the warmth spread without limit and read every living body its edge touches.

name: Spill Shield
description: Spill a bright guard in front of the user that follows the movement of the blow.

name: Reach Flare
description: Throw a flare far out across open ground to burst on a distant opponent.

name: Roaming Flame
description: Send a loose bright flame drifting over the ground that burns whatever it touches.

name: Boundless Cleanse
description: Spread a clean white heat as far as the user can feel and burn poison from every ally within it.

name: Broad Sunmend
description: Spread slow healing warmth over a whole line of wounded and close the shallow cuts of each.

name: Swelling Light
description: Let a swelling light roll out and weigh down every hostile qi it passes over.

name: Unbounded Blaze
description: Loose a blaze with no edge that rolls over the open field and burns without letup until the qi runs dry.

name: Sunfall
description: Let a shaft of the whole sun fall on one wide stretch of ground and sear it black.
